sheets_documents: Addendum 3 (new panels note), E-2.1 (Dillons, KC, EPB schedules), K2.0 item 68

question: Addendum 3 notes three new panels 'to manage lighting and sound' and the Dillons panel to be removed carries 7 TV-outlet and 3 POS circuit lines, but no sound / AV system, TV / video distribution, data / telecom cabling, network rack or security device is drawn on any sheet: please state whether any low-voltage system other than the POS J-boxes (K2.0 item 68) is in the general contractor's bid and issue its drawings.

subject: ADA lift pit and '(N) structural beam below'
question: A-6.21 KN12 refers to a '(N) structural beam below' the ADA lift 'see S-2.10' that is not on S-2.10, and the lift pit slab thickness, reinforcing and concrete strength are not detailed: please issue the pit and beam details.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines S-09 (pit base and beam), D-28 (pit cut 21.1 SF) and the special inspection trigger (G-15, concrete above 2,500 psi) cannot be priced.

subject: Stair 1 landing supports
question: S-2.10 places the two 'HSS4x4x1/4' labels on diagonal lines at the landing corners while 5/S-3.20 draws vertical posts, and the landing is dimensioned 4'-4" x 3'-9": please confirm whether the landing is supported on vertical posts or kicker braces and the landing size.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines S-03 (HSS8x4 landing beams), S-04 (landing framing), S-05 (posts 15.9 LF) and S-06 (base plates, 8 epoxy rods) depend on the support type.

sheets_documents: Exit-stair set: A-6.10, A-6.11, S-2.10, S-3.10, ENERCALC
subject: Exit-stair landing size, pan fill and guard
question: The exit-stair landing is dimensioned 5'-0" x 4'-0" on A-6.10 while the ENERCALC landing beam spans 6.0 ft and a 6'-3" dimension sits outside the landing, the pan-fill concrete depth and strength are not stated (special inspection applies above 2,500 psi), and the A-6.11 sections show a picket guard where the plan shows walls on both sides: please confirm the landing size, the fill depth and strength, and whether a guard is required.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Stairs & railing: lines X-03 (pan fill, no depth), X-04 / X-05 (landing beams and framing), X-12 (guard, no LF) and the inspection line G-15 cannot be fixed.

subject: Typical stud size
question: The S-2.10 / S-2.20 legend states '400S162-54 @ 16" typ. all walls' while the S-1.10 schedule states '362S162-54 @ 16"' for the ground and second levels: please confirm the typical stud and track size.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior walls: all new partitions (S-18 and the architectural partition takeoff) and the dumbwaiter shaft walls are priced on one of the two sizes.

subject: Sloped mezzanine floor for exit-stair headroom
question: A-1.20 KN17 shows a 26 SF sloped mezzanine floor for the exit-stair headroom clearance with no structural detail on S-2.20 or the exit-stair S-sheets: please issue the construction of the sloped floor and state under which permit it is built.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Other required scope and Stairs & railing: line S-15 has no construction to price and the permit split (TI vs 26016-10000-18605) is open.

subject: Existing door access to the main building and untagged mezzanine wall
question: The exit-stair A-0.20 notes an '(E) door access to the main building (not code compliant)' to be removed without location, size or infill construction, and A-1.20 draws an untagged dashed double-line wall (14.4 LF) inside the exit-stair limit of work: please locate and size the door removal and infill, and state under which permit the untagged wall is removed.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Stairs & railing and Demolition: lines X-20 (door removal and infill) and D-24 (wall 14.4 LF) cannot be quantified or assigned to a permit.

sheets_documents: S-2.10, S-2.20, S-1.10 (raster only at 110 dpi), 4/S-3.10, A-9.10 headers
subject: Vector S-2.10 / S-2.20: shear-wall marks, holdowns, saddles, headers
question: The S-2.10 / S-2.20 sheets on hand are 110 dpi rasters on which the Sure-Board shear-wall marks (S-1.10 schedule marks 1-4) and S/HDU4 / S/HDU6 holdown symbols are not legible, the box-beam column-saddle count (4/S-3.10) and the attic joist extents cannot be confirmed, and the headers at new wall openings are 'see detail' with no count: please issue vector S-2.10 / S-2.20 (or legible prints) with the shear-wall and header schedule applied.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines S-17 (Sure-Board shear walls and holdowns), S-16 (headers), S-12 (attic joist extents, 1,538 SF) and the saddle anchors for G-14 special inspection cannot be quantified.

subject: Hazardous-materials survey
question: No bid document requires or provides a hazardous-materials survey for the 1920s building (ceiling coffers, plaster, flooring mastics, pipe insulation to be demolished): please state whether a survey exists, its findings, and whether any abatement is in the bid.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Demolition and Other required scope: line G-28 (survey / abatement) has no scope and the coffer / plaster demolition (D-20) could become abatement work.

subject: Untagged dashed enclosure in the existing kitchen
question: A-1.10 draws an untagged dashed double-line enclosure 12.3 x 14.7 ft in the (E) kitchen next to the two KN4 walk-ins: please confirm whether it is a third walk-in box, an equipment enclosure or a partition to be removed.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Demolition: line D-02 (181 SF) is priced as a walk-in removal by assumption.

subject: Exit-stair steel finish and exit signage
question: The finish of the exit-stair steel (paint system or galvanizing) is not specified (stair 1 calls P-6) and the exit-sign symbols on the A-0.20 exit-analysis plans are legible for one location only: please specify the steel finish and the exit sign / egress signage count and circuit for the new exit stair.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Stairs & railing: lines X-23 (finish) and X-22 (exit signs) have no specification or count.

subject: Exit-stair storefront and door hardware
question: The fixed storefront panel between the two new exit doors (4'-8" wide, height taken from the (E) door) has no mullion layout or frame section, and the panic hardware and closer sets for the two storefront doors and the 1-hr exit-access door are not specified: please issue the storefront elevation / section and the hardware sets.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Stairs & railing: lines X-15, X-16 (framing LF) and X-17 (hardware) are priced on assumed products.

subject: Item 46 Rational combi oven (existing, relocated)
question: K2.0 item 46 'RATIONAL #I COMBI CLASSIC' (cell highlighted, size not given, plumbing columns blank) is existing relocated while K3.0 shows two +68 in rough-ins: please state the model / size and its water, drain and electrical requirements.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Owner-provided equipment install and Plumbing: the combi rough-in and filter (FE-45, P-058) and the 208 V 3 ph connection (E-015) cannot be fixed.

sheets_documents: K2.0 item 22, K3.0 note, cut sheet
subject: Item 22 grease interceptor connection size
question: K2.0 gives item 22 Big Dipper W-350-IS a 4 in waste while the cut sheet shows 3 in inlet / outlet and K3.0 notes 'VFY. W/ PLUMBER': please confirm the connection sizes and the 3 in drain / 2 in vent of P-3 GT-1.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Plumbing: line P-019 / P-025 (3 in run to GT-1) and the direct waste of KS-1 (P-065) are sized on P-3.

subject: Plan vs schedule quantity differences
question: K1.0 draws item 95 (slant rack shelf) twice (scullery and service bar) against a scheduled quantity of 1, item 2 lockers as one bank against qty 5, items 1 and 10 as 6 and 5 shelving units against '1 LOT', and single bubbles for items 26 / 36 / 89 scheduled 2 each: please confirm the quantities.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items F&B equipment and Owner-provided equipment install: lines FE-95, FE-2, FE-1, FE-10, FE-26, FE-36, FE-89 carry the schedule quantity.

sheets_documents: K1.0 (EXISTING STORAGE AREA), K2.0 items 1 and 2, A-2.10
subject: Existing storage area in the TI scope
question: K2.0 items 1 (storage shelving) and 2 (five existing lockers, relocated) sit in the 'EXISTING STORAGE AREA' on K1.0: please confirm whether that area is inside the tenant-improvement scope and whether its finishes are touched.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items F&B equipment and Owner-provided equipment install: lines FE-1 and FE-2 and any finish work in that room.

subject: Construction of existing elements to be demolished
question: The drawings do not state the construction, height or material of the (E) ramp (KN10), raised platform and steps (KN12), curved stair to the mezzanine (KN11), mezzanine ceiling coffers and mouldings (A-1.20 KN14, 890 SF), the 72 mezzanine ceiling light fixtures (KN15), the mezzanine walls KN13 / KN4 (heights) or the extent of terrazzo patching (A-1.10 KN14): please provide them or confirm they are to be verified at a pre-bid site walk.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Demolition: lines D-07..D-11, D-20..D-23 and D-26 are quantified by area or length only and cannot be priced by removal type.

sheets_documents: P-2, P-3, P-4, M-4 (vertical risers), M-6 (hanger rods)
subject: Floor-to-floor heights for risers and hangers
question: The vertical risers (basement to first floor, first floor to mezzanine, mezzanine to the second-floor roof) and the hood hanger-rod lengths are not dimensioned on any M- or P-sheet: please state the floor-to-floor and floor-to-roof heights at the riser locations.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Plumbing and Mechanical: lines P-030, P-050 (sanitary and water risers), P-061 (gas riser) and M-018 (hanger rods) are counted EA with no length.

sheets_documents: P-2 (first-floor restroom headers), P-4 (HW beyond the 1 in label)
subject: Unlabeled pipe sizes on P-2 / P-4
question: The re-piped (E) first-floor restroom CW / HW branch headers and fixture drops below the 2 in CW / 1 in HW labels on P-2 (41 LF) and the HW run to the mezzanine lavatories beyond the 1 in label on P-4 (27.5 LF) carry no sizes: please label them.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Plumbing: lines P-051 and P-055 (and their insulation in P-057) cannot be priced by size.
